subs.title: AC2: two buttons are visible immediately on page load
AC3: both buttons are centered together in the viewport
REQ-FUNC-002: reveal a random nature image
AC4: no image is shown before the first click
AC5 & AC7: clicking the first button shows an image in place (no reload)
AC6: repeated clicks keep exactly one image and vary the selection
AC8: clicking the first button does not change the background color
AC11: clicking the second button changes the background color to a non-empty value
AC12: the picked color is a syntactically valid CSS color value and may vary across clicks
AC13: clicking the second button does not affect the displayed image area
AC9: the image pool contains exactly six distinct images
AC10: every pool image is served locally with no network dependency
AC1: header 'Testipalvelu' is visible at the top of the page on load
